title: Sunset and compatibility plan for Legacy Inference API v1 -> v2
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Execute a low-friction, low-risk sunset of the Legacy Inference API v1 in favor of v2 within a 3-month window while minimizing customer disruption. This ticket coordinates cross-functional launch planning (eng, docs, SDKs, console, support, sales) for versioning, migration guidance, release notes, and timed communications. We will provide: (1) clear migration guides and automated linting tools, (2) staged traffic cuts with telemetry-driven guardrails, (3) coordinated release notes and comms calendar, and (4) deprecation timelines with firm dates and opt-out paths for high-risk customers.
milestones: 2026-03-22: API spec (v2 compatibility matrix + backward-compat exceptions) finalized and approved
2026-04-05: Migration guide first draft and SDK compatibility tests published
2026-04-19: Console UX for version pinning and sunset flags implemented (ENG-4098 rollout)
2026-05-10: Beta migration cohort – invite 25 pilot customers; monitor errors and latency regressions
2026-05-24: Public migration guide + automated upgrade lint released; send first customer advisory
2026-06-01: Start soft-deprecation: v1 marked deprecated in Console and API headers
2026-06-15: Hard-deprecation window begins (rate-limited 429s for new v1 calls while migration support continues)

communication_plan: Week-by-week cadence: 3 weeks before soft-deprecation publish advisory to affected customers + docs; 2 weeks before, post blog and release notes; day of soft-deprecation show console banners and automated in-app nudges; weekly status digest to Sales and Support during beta and first 4 weeks post-deprecation. Channels: Docs site, in-product banner, customer advisory email, GitHub releases, changelog, and marketplace listings. Ensure Messaging matrix (why -> action -> timeline) is included in each artifact.
rollback_plan: If key telemetry shows >1% customer error increase or regressions in 95th percentile latency for top 50 customers during beta, pause automated rate limiting and open an emergency migration support path (extended enterprise override in Console). Post-mortem required within 72 hours. Re-enable v1 traffic routing by default until fixes are deployed.
migration_guide_summary: Provide a step-by-step guide: 1) Identify usage patterns (streaming vs batch vs embeddings); 2) Run the v2 compatibility lint tool against requests; 3) Update client SDK to v2+ and run integration smoke tests; 4) Switch to versioned endpoint with canary header and monitor metrics; 5) Roll forward once metrics stable. Include code examples, known incompatibilities, and a small server-side shim snippet for transient differences.
release_notes_summary: Heads-up: v1 will be deprecated and replaced by v2 which improves batching, KV-cache semantics, and structured output guarantees. Key changes listed with migration steps and links to SDK releases, migration guide, and support channels. Emphasize performance and reliability improvements and provide explicit dates for soft and hard deprecation.
